pages.text: The identity card is the $(bold)key$() of the wireless network: each card carries a unique ID. Right-click to activate and view its ID, tier and transfer rate.$(bold)Authorize:$() on the terminal's Security page, place the card in the authorization slot and press Authorize to add it to the whitelist (up to 8 cards per terminal).$(bold)Revoke:$() place the card in the slot and press Remove; its bound ports disconnect immediately.

$(bold)Binding ports:$() hold an authorized card and right-click an input/output port to bind it to the card's UUID; the port then checks the terminal by card every tick.$(br2)$(bold)Tier:$() only the Basic card exists for now. The tier sets the transfer rate; higher tiers will unlock stronger transfer in the future.$(br2)$(bold)Note:$() revoking a card or dismantling the terminal halts every port bound to it; re-authorizing restores them.
